versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Autonomous Sub-Agent Factory for OpenClaw.
- Enables orchestrator to generate, sandbox, benchmark, and route to disposable sub-agents based on recurring workload detection.
- Implements strict promotion guardrails: sub-agents must outperform the generalist model on at least 2 of 4 key metrics with no regressions and 100% security.
- Provides full lifecycle management, including concept drift detection, rollback, and automatic archiving of inactive sub-agents.
- Includes CLI tools for telemetry, synthesis, evaluation, routing, and lifecycle auditing.
